children.name: Onykia
children.description: Onykia — a genus of cephalopods.

children.name: Onykia appelloefi
children.description: Onykia appelloefi may be a species of squid in the family Onychoteuthidae. The species occurs in the Atlantic Ocean. It is a taxon inquirendum and it requires more research to confirm its validity as a species.

children.name: Onykia appellofi
children.description: Onykia appelloefi may be a species of squid in the family Onychoteuthidae. The species occurs in the Atlantic Ocean. It is a taxon inquirendum and it requires more research to confirm its validity as a species.

children.name: Onykia carriboea Lesueur, 1821
children.description: Onykia carriboea, the tropical clubhook squid, is a squid in the family Onychoteuthidae, the type species of the genus Onykia.

children.name: Onykia loennbergii
children.description: Onykia loennbergii, the Japanese hooked squid, is a species of squid in the family Onychoteuthidae, named by Swedish zoologist Einar Lönnberg. It occurs in the Western Pacific Ocean, at an estimated depth of 230–1200 m. The mantle length is approximately 300 mm.

children.name: Onykia robsoni
children.description: Onykia robsoni, the rugose hooked squid, is a species of squid in the family Onychoteuthidae. It occurs in the Antarctic Ocean, at an estimated depth of 250–550 meters. The mantle of this species grows to a length of 75 cm.

children.name: Onykia robusta
children.description: Onykia robusta, also known as the robust clubhook squid and often cited by the older name Moroteuthis robusta, is a species of squid in the family Onychoteuthidae. Reaching a mantle length of 2 m (6.6 ft) it is the largest member of its family and one of the largest of all cephalopods. The largest specimen with reliable catch data was found in the Bering Sea, a male with a total length of 3.72 m (12.2 ft) and weighing 41.73 kg (92.0 lb).

children.description: Walvisteuthis — a genus of cephalopods.

children.name: Walvisteuthis jeremiahi Vecchione, Sosnowski & R.E.Young, 2015
children.description: Walvisteuthis jeremiahi is a species of squid from the family Onychoteuthidae.

children.name: Walvisteuthis rancureli
children.description: Walvisteuthis rancureli is a species of squid from the family Onychoteuthidae. The species can be found in the Eastern Central Atlantic and Eastern Indian oceans, and members of the species are gonochoric.

children.name: Walvisteuthis youngorum
children.description: Walvisteuthis youngorum is a species of squid from the family Onychoteuthidae. They can be found off of the northern Hawaiian Islands. They are rarely seen due to the depth that they reside in, and have only been filmed once, in 2015.

children.description: thumb | right Notonykia africanae, the African clubhook-squid, is a species of squid in the family Onychoteuthidae.

children.name: Notonykia nesisi Bolstad, 2007

children.name: Onychoteuthis
children.description: Onychoteuthis — a genus of cephalopods.

children.name: Onychoteuthis banksii
children.description: Onychoteuthis banksii, the common clubhook squid, is a species of squid in the family Onychoteuthidae. It is the type species of the genus Onychoteuthis. This species was thought to have a worldwide distribution but with the revision of the genus Onychoteuthis in 2010, it is now accepted that Onychoteuthis banksii is restricted to the central and northern Atlantic and the Gulf of Mexico while a recently described species, Onychoteuthis horstkottei, is found in the Pacific Ocean.

children.name: Onychoteuthis bergii Lichtenstein, 1818
children.description: Onychoteuthis bergii is a species of hooked squid from the family Onychoteuthidae.

children.name: Onychoteuthis borealijaponica Okada, 1927
children.description: Onychoteuthis borealijaponica, the boreal clubhook squid, is a species of squid in the family Onychoteuthidae.

children.name: Onychoteuthis compacta
children.description: Onychoteuthis compacta is a species of squid in the family Onychoteuthidae, known to occur in Hawaiian waters. as well as in other areas of the Central Pacific and western north-central Atlantic, it probably has a circumglobar distribution. The species is known to have a mantle length of at least 122 mm for females and 127 mm for males.

children.description: Onychoteuthis horstkottei is a species of squid in the family Onychoteuthidae.

children.name: Onychoteuthis prolata Bolstad, Vecchione & R.E.Young, 2008

children.name: Filippovia knipovitchi
children.description: Filippovia knipovitchi, the smooth hooked squid, is a species of squid in the family Onychoteuthidae and the sole member of the genus Filippovia. It is found in the Antarctic and Atlantic Oceans, and reaches a mantle length of 35 cm.

children.name: Moroteuthopsis
children.description: Moroteuthopsis — a genus of cephalopods.

children.name: Moroteuthopsis ingens
children.description: Moroteuthopsis ingens, the greater hooked squid, is a species of squid in the family Onychoteuthidae. It occurs worldwide in subantarctic oceans.

children.name: Moroteuthopsis longimana
children.description: Moroteuthopsis longimana, previously Kondakovia longimana, the giant warty squid or longarm octopus squid, is a large species of hooked squid. It attains a mantle length of at least 85 cm (33 in) and probably over 1.15 m. The largest complete specimen of this species, measuring 2.3 m in total length, was found in Antarctica in 2000.
